automationNotes: Doc: https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/launch/setup-production-and-non-production-environment — production path through open Production on Deployments. **Auto Deploy on Commits** / **Save Deployment Settings** (Deployments tab) are optional steps: the doc shows them for **Git-based** Launch projects; **file-upload** projects often omit that toggle (env-deployments.html). Optional steps skip when the control is absent. Domains → New Domain → dismiss modal; then Environments → Production row. If you extend this flow with a Development env, repeat optional auto-deploy enable for Git projects only.
